contract_summary.SESSION_TYPE: Server-side stateful session tokens (SHA-256 hashed in database, raw token held by client)

/auth/google/start.purpose: Initiate Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow with signed state cookie
/auth/google/start.mobile_fit: Can initiate via system browser / Custom Tab; requires whitelisting mobile redirect URI

/auth/google/callback.purpose: Google callback verifying state, exchanging auth code, resolving user, and creating single-use exchange ticket
/auth/google/callback.mobile_fit: Must redirect to mobile deep link (otravelz://auth/callback?auth_ticket=...) when mobile initiated

/auth/session/exchange.purpose: Burns 60-second single-use auth ticket; returns active session token and user profile
/auth/session/exchange.mobile_fit: Ideal for native mobile apps to exchange ticket for bearer session token without token in URL

/auth/me.purpose: Returns authenticated UserProfile or unauthenticated status
/auth/me.mobile_fit: Perfect for native mobile app launch/background session verification

/auth/logout.purpose: Revokes session in database and clears cookie
/auth/logout.mobile_gap: Does not currently read Authorization: Bearer header. Surgical update required for mobile logout session revocation.

verdict: Backend auth provides 90% of mobile requirements. Surgical updates to /auth/logout (bearer support) and /auth/google/callback (mobile scheme redirect) provide 100% native mobile safety with zero third-party dependencies.
